tasks.title: Improve color contrast and define accessible tokens
tasks.description: Audit and update color tokens in src/index.css and tailwind config to meet WCAG AA for normal text and large text. Add contrast tokens for states.
steps: Extract current color variables in src/index.css into a single :root token block (--bg-primary, --text-primary, --accent-active, --accent-muted, etc.)
Run automated contrast checks (axe-core) and list failing selectors
Update tokens to accessible values and add --focus, --hover, --disabled variants
Create a small CSS utility file with accessible alias classes for critical components (btn-primary, btn-secondary, badge)
acceptance: All primary text passes WCAG AA (4.5:1)
Primary CTA and badges meet contrast requirements
No new visual regressions on desktop/mobile snapshots

tasks.title: Clarify CTA hierarchy and affordance
tasks.description: Standardize CTA sizes, spacing, and color to reduce visual competition and guide primary user flows.
steps: Define primary, secondary, tertiary CTA styles in index.css and tailwind tokens
Audit main screens to identify competing CTAs and reduce to 1 primary action per screen
Increase clickable areas to 44px and ensure visual emphasis on primary actions
Update components/Button.jsx to consume new tokens and variants
acceptance: Primary action visible within first viewport
Updated Button component has variant prop and documentation

tasks.title: Add lazy-loading and code-splitting for heavy routes/components
tasks.description: Improve initial load by lazy-loading non-critical components and routes using React.lazy + Suspense and dynamic imports.
steps: Identify heavy components (ARViewer, InstitutionalHUD, large charts) via bundle analyzer
Replace static imports with React.lazy and wrap with Suspense fallbacks
Add route-level code splitting for rarely-used pages
Verify that server-side assets still build and that snapshots for critical routes remain unchanged
acceptance: No runtime errors from lazy-loaded components
